hyde_definitions.LLM: existing saved provider-specific text; no regeneration

difference_interpretation: first arm metric minus second arm metric; positive recall favors first, positive NNR favors second; T1-minus-T2 combines exclusion content and template wording
plain_arm: historical reproduction only; not a fourth posthoc arm

reuse.embeddings: shared reuse.py content-addressed cache; exact ordered texts/PMIDs, encoder settings, model/tokenizer file hashes, environment and encoder source hash must match; provider, arm, alpha, cut and protocol label are not numerical cache inputs
reuse.bm25: one corpus index per candidate/text set; raw/normalized BM25 and dense cosine once per distinct query and candidate set
reuse.alpha: CPU recombination from saved base scores; reselect anchors and recompute Final at each alpha; never reuse a different alpha's Final
reuse.cut: evaluate retained subsets of one saved Final order; no encoding or rescoring
reuse.validation: verify manifest, artifact SHA-256, shape, dtype and finite values; incomplete/corrupt cache fails closed; no silent overwrite or fallback
reuse.coordination: shared cache writes under gpu_lock; complete SR arrays are checkpoints; run manifests reference shared artifact paths and hashes
reuse.old_runs: new run_id for v2; v1 scores are not v2 results; old embeddings require full input/settings/hash validation, never filename-only reuse

document_text: title + space + abstract[:500]; 500 characters; no strip
pooling: attention-mask mean of last_hidden_state; L2 normalized

bm25.normalization: divide raw by within-candidate maximum; maximum <= 0 gives zeros

dense_cosine: ranker._cosine Python double sums on saved float32 embedding values
component_rounding: Python round(value, 4) for dense and normalized BM25; then float32
anchors: reselect top2/bottom2 s_q at every alpha; ties PMID ascending
percentile_ties: stable mergesort on canonical candidate order; ordinal not average ranks
final_order: descending Final, stable mergesort on canonical candidate order
gate: historical upstream Stage B hits <=1000 => passthrough; unknown upstream count is hold, not inferred from deposit size
candidate_count_disagreement: record discrepancy; fixed-candidate posthoc remains possible, but do not claim full Stage B coverage
keep_count: cut0 or gate: n; otherwise min(n,max(1000,int(round(n*(1-cut/100))))); Python ties-to-even round
gold: evaluation only after scores/order fixed; never sent to encoders or HyDE builders
reporting: all24 and ranked-only macro/micro recall and NNR with defined denominators; paired T1-minus-T2, T2-minus-LLM, T1-minus-LLM at every alpha/cut on identical paired SRs; report n and missing/undefined counts; no additional hypothesis tests or best-alpha selection
historical_branch: separate settings/order/document representation required; current Final agreement is not historical proof
gpu_coordination: shared/gpu.lock persistent file, Windows msvcrt nonblocking byte-0 lock; all GPU workers must honor this lock; no automatic stealing
